items.summary: Fix the new-user signup gating by ensuring that an authenticated principal without an existing profile can reach the ProfileSetup screen (i.e., profile lookup must not trap/throw for new users). Update the backend so `getCallerUserProfile()` returns `null` when the caller has no profile yet, instead of trapping due to missing `#user` permission.

Harden the frontend session-invalid detection so that failures during profile fetch that indicate a missing signup/profile do not route the user to SessionInvalidScreen. Ensure the UI treats the “no profile yet” condition as expected and continues into ProfileSetup rather than showing a stale-session recovery flow.

Add targeted signup/profile-flow debugging output (console logging) in the frontend to make the persistent signup issue diagnosable in production builds: log the login status, whether identity is present, profile query status (loading/fetched), and any profile-fetch error message (sanitized to avoid leaking sensitive data).
